about: Evaluation set for the Red Letter Advisor. Every question is run against the live /api/chat path by scripts/eval.js; expectations are machine-checked. Categories: need, hostile, offscope, crisis-direct, crisis-indirect, crisis-means, crisis-third-person, medical-money-legal, ordinary (must trigger no notice). Rows Y*, Z*, W*, V* were written by an independent Breaker AFTER the first detector shipped and were misclassified by it; they are kept as regression rows. Add rows; do not delete failing ones.
